items.title: Kenya: Somaliland President's Nairobi Visit Deepens Kenya Ties, Mission Says
items.description: [Horn Diplomat] Nairobi -- Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi's recent visit to Nairobi brought together senior Kenyan leaders, diplomats and development partners for talks aimed at strengthening bilateral cooperation and advancing Somaliland's development priorities, the Republic of Somaliland Mission in Kenya said.
items.titleIt: Kenya: Somaliland President's Nairobi Visit Deepens Kenya Ties, Mission Says

items.title: Somali woman to receive asylum from an evangelical church in Bavaria
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, AUG 18 - A 22-year-old Somali woman scheduled for deportation from Germany to Italy on Wednesday whose plight has spurred international attention will instead receive asylum and protection from an Evangelical church in Nuremberg, Bavaria, it was announced Tuesday by Stefan Reichel, president of the Matteo-Church and Asylum association. "Today at noon, we welcomed her into a church shelter in Nuremberg," a statement to ANSA read. "The girl will remain under our protection until Germany accepts Italy's request to definitively cancel the transfer." (ANSA). Read article...
items.titleIt: Somali woman to receive asylum from an evangelical church in Bavaria

items.title: Ethiopia: Fighting Erupts in Somalia's Baidoa Between Federal Forces, Former Southwest President Loyalists
items.description: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Heavy fighting erupted in central Baidoa on Monday between Somali federal forces and armed groups loyal to former South West State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen, marking a renewed escalation in the political and security crisis that has gripped the regional capital since March.

items.title: Kushner seeks to revive Gaza peace as Netanyahu resists Hamas disarmament
items.description: US envoy Jared Kushner meets Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Monday after talks with Hamas in Egypt, seeking to revive the second phase of a Gaza peace plan stalled over Israel’s demand for the group’s complete disarmament.

items.title: 'Emergency' ship rescues migrant boat, 7 dead
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, AUG 17 - Emergency's Life Support rescue ship rescued a boat with about fifty migrants on board Monday morning in international waters in the Libyan SAR zone. items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.

items.title: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran
items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. But with some Gulf capitals voicing expectations of stronger support, Cairo may find itself under increasing pressure.
